final: SELECT p.SEX AS SEX, AVG(pp.avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(pp.avg_ratio) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM (SELECT l.ID AS ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(CAST(l.ALP AS REAL) / l.GPT) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l2 WHERE l2.ID = l.ID AND l2."U-PRO" = '-') GROUP BY l.ID) pp JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = pp.ID GROUP BY p.SEX
